The '''Hush-98 comlink''', manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], was a type of handheld [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] commonly used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:QuiGon_hush98.jpg|thumb|left|Qui-Gon Jinn using his Hush-98.]]
The Hush-98 [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] was a compact and complex model of comlink manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. It was lightweight, weighting only half a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]], and boasted multiple functions that gave its users an edge over their enemies. In addition to standard communication abilities, the Hush-98 featured a 100-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] range, variable frequencies, encoding, a [[Locator/Legends|locator]], silence projector that created a field of white noise around the user (allowing for private conversations),<ref name="SWCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and the capability to store and transmit complex data, such as the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] sample data collected from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Components of the Hush-98 included a reception [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]], voice pickup, an encoding selector, sound projectors, a sound reproduction matrix, and frequency search control.<ref name="SWCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Hush-98 comlink as it appeared in the movie was a modified woman's razor (a "Gillette Sensor-Excel for Women").

The toy version of the Hush-98 comlink appears in the expansion pack ''[[W:c:cnc:Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 - Yuri's Revenge|Command & Conquer: Yuri's Revenge]]''. Einstein can be seen holding it in the briefing video in the first Allied mission.
